info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Insurance Claims Claims Deny-v5-spec
info.description: The Deny Insurance Claims API enables businesses to manage the denial process for insurance claims efficiently. This endpoint allows authorized users to remove specific claims from approval consideration based on predefined denial criteria. Typical consumers include insurance adjusters and claims processors who need to maintain accurate records and expedite claims handling. By integrating this API, organizations can improve operational workflows and ensure compliance with denial regulations.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to deny a claim, which may involve providing a reason for the denial. Once a claim is denied, it cannot be reinstated through this endpoint.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a deny operation for a claim. The payload must include the necessary details to accurately process the denial request.

200.description: The request was successful, and the claim has been denied.

DeleteInsuranceClaimsClaimsDenyRequest.description: The request body that specifies the details for rejecting a claim operation.
